clip_key: # Goofy kerbal radio with Mission Control in orbit, coast and landed. New keys: sp_
# Columns and values: audio/lonapse/README.md. UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line.

english: Everything still normal. | All still normal. | Everything's normal here.
So far so good. | Good so far. | No problems so far.
Things are quiet. | It's quiet. | Quiet up here.
Stick to the plan. | Keep to the plan. | Follow the plan, {vessel}.
All quiet over here. | All quiet here. | Nothing going on over here.
Readings look fine. | Readings are fine. | The numbers look good.
What a beautiful view. | Beautiful view. | What a view. | [orbit] Look at {here} down there. Beautiful. | [landed] What a view of {here}.
spanish_rt: |  |  | Mira {here} ahí abajo. Precioso. | Qué vista de {here}.

english: Proceeding as planned. | Going as planned. | All according to plan.
Systems are green. | All systems green. | Green across the board.
Nothing new to report. | Nothing to report. | No news here.
Checking instruments. | Checking the instruments. | Instrument check.
You look good from here. | You look good from down here. | Looking good, {vessel}.
All nominal on the ground. | Ground says all nominal. | Everything is nominal down here.
Telemetry is stable. | Telemetry looks stable. | Steady telemetry.
Control, all good here. | Control, all fine here. | Control, {vessel} is all good.
Copy. Clean telemetry. | Copy. Telemetry is clean. | Copy that. Clean data.
How's everything out there? | How are things out there? | How's it going, {vessel}?
Very good, no problems. | Very good. No problems. | All good. Nothing wrong.
Requesting heading confirmation. | Please confirm our heading. | Control, confirm heading?
Heading confirmed. | Heading confirmed. | Confirmed. Heading is good.
Thanks, control. | Thank you, Control. | Thanks.
Radio check. Do you read us? | Radio check. Do you copy? | Radio check, {vessel}. Read us?
Loud and clear, control. | Loud and clear. | We hear you fine, Control.
Control, fuel is fine. | Control, fuel looks good. | Control, fuel is okay.
Copy. Thanks for the report. | Copy. Thanks. | Thanks for the fuel report.
Control, all quiet up here. | Control, it's quiet up here. | Control, nothing happening up here.
Perfect. That's how we like it. | Perfect. We like quiet. | Good. That's how we like it.

spanish: Tenemos un mensaje de vuestras familias.
english: We have a message from your families. | Message from your families. | Your families sent a message.
What do they say? | What did they say? | And?
Come home soon. | Come home soon. | Come home soon, they say.
Control, how much longer? | Control, how much longer? | Control, are we nearly done?
A little longer. Patience. | A bit longer. Be patient. | Not long now. Patience.

spanish: Confirmad estado de los paneles solares.
english: Confirm solar panel status. | Solar panel status, please. | Confirm your panels, {vessel}.
Panels good. Battery charging. | Panels fine. Batteries charging. | Panels good. Charging.

spanish: Control, hay migas flotando por todas partes.
english: Control, there are crumbs floating everywhere. | Control, crumbs are floating everywhere. | Control, the cabin is full of crumbs.
The cookies again? | Cookies again? | Was it the cookies?
They're space cookies. They don't count. | Space cookies. They don't count. | Those were space cookies. Different rules.
Control, I lost a sock. | Control, my sock is gone. | Control, I've lost a sock.
Where did you last see it? | Where did you see it last? | When did you last see it?
Drifting past the window. | Floating past the window. | Outside the window. Waving.

spanish: Control, llevo tres mil estrellas contadas.
english: Control, I've counted three thousand stars. | Control, I counted three thousand stars. | Control, three thousand stars so far.
And how many to go? | How many left? | And how many are left?
All the others. | The rest. | All of the other ones.

spanish: Control, el inodoro hace un ruido raro.
english: Control, the toilet is making a weird noise. | Control, the toilet makes a weird noise. | Control, the toilet is gurgling.
Don't touch anything, please. | Please don't touch anything. | Hands off, please.
Too late. | Too late. | Already touched it.
Control, are we there yet? | Control, are we there? | Control, almost there?
No. You're still in orbit. | No. Still in orbit. | Negative. You're in orbit around {here}.
spanish_rt: |  | Negativo. Estáis en órbita alrededor de {here}.

english: How about now? | And now? | How about now?
Control, what's the score of the game? | Control, what's the score? | Control, how's the game going?
Two to one. We're losing. | Two to one. We're behind. | We're losing, two to one.
Tell us if we score. | Let us know if we score. | Call us when we score.

spanish: Control, vemos un trozo de chatarra.
english: Control, we see a piece of junk. | Control, there's junk out here. | Control, a piece of junk just passed.
Put it in the log. | Log it, please. | Note it in the log.
Logged. Its name is Gustavo. | Logged. We named it Gustavo. | It's in the log. Name: Gustavo.

spanish: Control, un tornillo nos está siguiendo.
english: Control, a bolt is following us. | Control, a bolt is following us. | Control, there's a bolt flying with us.

spanish: Es vuestro. Se soltó en el despegue.
english: It's yours. It came loose at liftoff. | That's yours. It fell off at liftoff. | It's one of yours. From liftoff.
Now it's our pet. | It's our pet now. | We're keeping it.

spanish: Hay un panel viejo ahí fuera.
english: There's an old panel out there. | There's an old panel floating out there. | Control, old panel outside.
It's from the last mission. | That's from the last mission. | Last mission left that.
We'll call it Bartolo. | We'll name it Bartolo. | Its name is Bartolo now.
Control, are we falling? | Control, are we falling? | Control, is this falling?

spanish: Sí, pero muy rápido de lado.
english: Yes, but very fast sideways. | Yes. Sideways, very fast. | Yes. But sideways, so you miss {here}.
spanish_rt: |  | Sí. Pero de lado, así que no le dais a {here}.

english: Then all is well. | Okay then. | Then it's fine.
Control, that's ten laps already. | Control, ten laps done. | Control, that's lap ten.

spanish: Una más y os damos medalla.
english: One more and you get a medal. | One more for a medal. | Another one and you get a medal.

spanish: Control, creo que necesitamos más puntales.
english: Control, I think we need more struts. | Control, we need more struts. | Control, I want more struts.

spanish: Estáis en órbita. No hacen falta.
english: You're in orbit. You don't need them. | You're in orbit. No struts needed. | Not in orbit, you don't.
You always need them. | You always need struts. | There's no such thing as enough struts.
Control, can we add another booster? | Control, can we add a booster? | Control, one more booster?
Not from up there. | Not from up there. | You can't do that from orbit.
I'll write it down for next time. | I'll note it for next time. | Next time, then.
Control, supply report. | Control, supplies report. | Control, here's the supply count.
Go ahead. | Go on. | Go ahead, {vessel}.

spanish: Quedan dos galletas y un pepinillo.
english: Two cookies and a pickle left. | Two cookies and one pickle. | One pickle. Two cookies. That's it.

spanish: Control, he hecho una bola de agua gigante.
english: Control, I made a giant ball of water. | Control, I made a huge water ball. | Control, look at my giant water ball.
Keep it away from the panels. | Not near the panels. | Keep it away from the electronics.
Oops. | Whoops. | Uh oh.

spanish: Control, experimento nuevo: girar sin parar.
english: Control, new experiment: spinning nonstop. | Control, new experiment: spinning forever. | Control, experiment: nonstop spinning.
Result? | Results? | And the result?
Dizzy. Very dizzy. | Dizzy. Extremely dizzy. | I'm dizzy. So dizzy.

spanish: Control, mi bocadillo se ha escapado.
english: Control, my sandwich escaped. | Control, my sandwich got away. | Control, my sandwich escaped again.
I'm sure it will come back. | It'll come back. | Sandwiches always come back.

spanish: Lo veo. Va hacia la escotilla.
english: I see it. It's heading for the hatch. | I see it. It's going for the hatch. | There it is. Near the hatch.

spanish: Control, la ventana tiene una mancha.
english: Control, the window has a smudge. | Control, there's a smudge on the window. | Control, the window is dirty.

spanish: Es la marca de tu nariz.
english: That's your nose print. | That's your nose. | Your nose did that.
Control, I have hiccups. | Control, hiccups. | Control, I've got the hiccups.
Drink water upside down. | Drink water upside down. | Try drinking upside down.
Everything is upside down up here. | It's all upside down up here. | Which way is down?
Control, do you deliver to orbit? | Control, do you deliver to orbit? | Control, can we order delivery?
Only pizza. It takes a few months. | Pizza only. A few months, though. | Only pizza. Delivery takes months.

spanish: Con doble de queso, por favor.
english: Double cheese, please. | Extra cheese, please. | Double cheese for us.

spanish: Control, he sacado una foto preciosa.
english: Control, I took a gorgeous photo. | Control, I took an amazing picture. | Control, best photo ever.
Of what? | Of what? | What's on it?
Of my finger. | My finger. | Mostly my finger.
Control, are we winning the space race? | Control, are we winning the race? | Control, who's ahead in the space race?
You're the only ones racing. | You're the only ones in it. | Nobody else is racing.
Then we're in first place! | First place, then! | So we're winning!
Control, I found a rock. | Control, I found a rock. | Control, there's a rock here on {here}.
spanish_rt: |  | Control, aquí en {here} hay una roca.

english: Excellent! What kind? | Great! What kind? | Wonderful. What type?
The rock kind. | A rock kind. | The rocky kind.

spanish: Control, bandera plantada. Un poco torcida.
english: Control, flag planted. A bit crooked. | Control, flag is in. Little crooked. | Control, flag planted on {here}. Slightly crooked.
spanish_rt: |  | Control, bandera plantada en {here}. Un poco torcida.

english: Crooked, but proud. | Crooked, but proud. | Proudly crooked.
Control, I can jump really high here. | Control, I can jump so high here. | Control, the jumping here is amazing.
Don't jump into orbit. | Don't jump into orbit. | Please don't reach orbit on foot.
No promises. | Can't promise. | No promises.
Control, I like this place. | Control, I like it here. | Control, {here} is nice. I like it.
You can't stay. | You can't stay. | No staying.
Not even a little while? | Not even a bit? | Just a little while?
Control, we parked well, right? | Control, nice parking, right? | Control, we parked okay?
Almost upright. Almost. | Nearly upright. Nearly. | Almost straight. Almost.

spanish: Control, ¿me da tiempo a ir al baño?
english: Control, do I have time for the bathroom? | Control, is there time for the bathroom? | Control, quick bathroom break?
You should have gone before. | You should have gone before. | Should have gone earlier.
I'll hold it. | I'll wait. | I'll hold it.
Control, did you load the sandwiches? | Control, sandwiches on board? | Control, did the sandwiches get loaded?
Double ration, like you asked. | Double ration. As requested. | Double, like you asked.
Triple would have been better. | Triple would be better. | Should have been triple.

spanish: Control, tengo muchas ganas de volar.
english: Control, I really want to fly. | Control, I want to fly. | Control, can we go now?

spanish: Primero termina la lista de comprobación.
english: First finish the checklist. | Checklist first. | Finish the checklist first.
What checklist? | Checklist? | Which checklist?
Control, shall we add one more strut? | Control, one more strut? | Control, can we add a strut?
It already has forty. | It has forty already. | There are forty already.
Forty-one sounds better. | Forty-one sounds nicer. | Forty-one is a better number.

spanish: Control, este viaje es muy largo.
english: Control, this trip is really long. | Control, this trip is so long. | Control, this is taking forever.
It's space. It's big. | Space is big. | It's space. Space is big.
Someone should make it smaller. | Someone should shrink it. | Make it smaller, then.
Control, want to play I spy? | Control, I spy? | Control, play I spy with us?
Okay. You start. | Fine. You go first. | Okay. You start.
I spy something black. | I spy something black. | Something black. Guess.
Control, when do we get there? | Control, when do we arrive? | Control, how long until we're there?

spanish: Mira el reloj de la misión.
english: Check the mission clock. | Look at the mission clock. | Check the clock. Day {day} so far.
spanish_rt: |  | Mira el reloj. Vamos por el día {day}.

english: It ran out of batteries. | Its batteries died. | The clock is out of batteries.

spanish: Control, he visto una estrella fugaz.
english: Control, I saw a shooting star. | Control, shooting star! | Control, I just saw a shooting star.
Did you make a wish? | Did you wish for something? | Make a wish?
Yes. More cookies. | Yes. More cookies. | Cookies. More of them.

spanish: Control, ¿puedo salir a dar un paseo?
english: Control, can I go out for a walk? | Control, can I go for a walk? | Control, permission for a little walk?
No spacewalk today. | No spacewalk today. | Not today.
What if I wear a leash? | With a leash? | What if I use a leash?

spanish: Control, la cuchara se ha pegado al techo.
english: Control, the spoon stuck to the ceiling. | Control, the spoon is stuck to the ceiling. | Control, my spoon is on the ceiling.
With magnets? | Magnets? | Magnetic?
With jam. | Jam. | No. Jam.
